threat_event: Business email compromise: an attacker in a staff mailbox, or a look-alike domain, sends changed bank details for an overseas agent or carrier, and a wire is sent to the attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No call-back on changed payment instructions; one person creates and releases wires up to $25,000; no impersonation protection or external-sender tag; no fraud training; 2026-05 near-miss caught only by chance
existing_controls: Bank MFA; owner approval above $25,000; MFA on named mailboxes
treatment_plan: Call-back to a number on file for any new or changed beneficiary; dual approval in the bank portal for every wire to a new or changed beneficiary; external-sender tag and impersonation protection; payment fraud training; confirm the insurer's social engineering coverage conditions

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts computers and the synced Client Records Archive and steals client files, including importer identification numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; no EDR; antivirus alerts in business hours only; archive synced to desktops; backup never restore-tested; no inventory of where importer numbers are stored
existing_controls: MFA on SaaS; MSP patching and antivirus; firewall; full-disk encryption
treatment_plan: Training and quarterly phishing simulations; MSP-managed EDR with alert monitoring; suite alerts for mass downloads and new forwarding rules; data map of importer identification numbers; restore tests (R-006)

threat_event: The shared entries@ account is taken over by password guessing or a phishing page, exposing client documents and letting the attacker send mail as the entry team
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared password known to 3 people and stored in the printer; MFA excluded; password unchanged since the former Entry Writer left
existing_controls: Suite lockout after failed sign-ins
treatment_plan: Convert entries@ to a shared mailbox reached through named accounts with MFA; give the printer a scan-only connector with its own restricted credential; change the password at once

threat_event: A breach of customs records is not reported to the CBP Security Operations Center within 72 hours, with the compromised importer identification numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No procedure; staff do not know the duty; no list of where importer numbers are stored, so the numbers cannot be listed quickly
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: 72-hour CBP notice step in POL-03 and the P08 runbook with a prepared email template; importer number data map; training

threat_event: A former employee signs in to the customs platform, suite, or a carrier portal after leaving, and the CBP employee list is not updated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination checklist; former Entry Writer's platform access lasted 19 days and her CBP list update was 11 days late; carrier portal passwords not changed after departures
existing_controls: Named platform and suite accounts with MFA
treatment_plan: Last-day checklist covering every system, shared passwords, keys, and the CBP terminated-employee list within 30 days; monthly account reconciliation

threat_event: Client Records Archive cannot be restored after deletion, corruption, or encryption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup never restore-tested; one shared MSP admin login without MFA could delete the copies
existing_controls: Daily backup with 1-year retention
treatment_plan: First restore test by the MSP; quarterly restore tests recorded; named MSP accounts with MFA on the console; immutable retention if the service offers it

threat_event: Customs platform outage longer than the 4-hour RTO stops entries and ISFs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single platform; vendor RTO of 8 hours is longer than the BIA target; no standby broker arrangement
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 availability commitments
treatment_plan: Written standby arrangement with another licensed broker for urgent entries and ISFs; vendor status alerts; ask for a 4-hour RTO at renewal

threat_event: Internet outage stops access to every SaaS system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Staff can work from home on company laptops
treatment_plan: MSP installs a cellular failover router; work-from-home step in the contingency plan

threat_event: Shared carrier or terminal portal login is used by a former employee or an attacker to change bookings or view client shipments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared login per carrier used by 4 staff; passwords in a spreadsheet on the shared drive; not changed after departures
existing_controls: Spreadsheet folder limited to customs staff
treatment_plan: Named portal users where carriers offer them; company password manager for the rest; change all portal passwords now and at each departure

threat_event: CBP Regulatory Audit finds that originals were destroyed after scanning without an approved alternative storage method
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper shredded since 2023 without the 30-day advance notice, written procedures, or a yearly test (163.5(b)(1)-(2))
existing_controls: Scans filed by shipment in the archive
treatment_plan: Send the advance notice to CBP Regulatory Audit; written scanning and retrieval procedure; yearly retrieval test; keep paper until 30 days after the notice

threat_event: Client records are disclosed to service providers or tools without the client's written authorization
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client terms and POAs do not authorize disclosure to the MSP, SaaS vendors, or the AI feature; vendor confidentiality terms unchecked
existing_controls: Customs platform contract has confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Counsel drafts a client terms clause authorizing named categories of service providers; send to all active clients; check confidentiality terms with the MSP and backup service

threat_event: AI classification suggestions are accepted without licensed broker review, leading to wrong tariff numbers, wrong duty payments, and a supervision finding
threat_source: AI model error and process gap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor switched the feature on in 2026-04; Entry Writers accept suggestions; entry reviews by licensed brokers are not recorded
existing_controls: Entry Supervisor reviews new-client entries
treatment_plan: AI suggestions require licensed broker approval for new products; recorded monthly entry review sample; see P10

threat_event: Staff paste client invoices into public AI chatbots that keep or train on the data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No AI rules; free chatbots used for product descriptions and translation
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-02 Part C rule against client data in public AI tools; block known chatbot sites on company computers if misuse continues; training

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool gives attackers access to every computer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has administrator access to all computers; no review of MSP security; no MSP incident notice term
existing_controls: MSP states it uses MFA on its console (not evidenced)
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review (questionnaire, MFA evidence, technician list, subcontractors); 24-hour incident notice and recovery time terms at renewal

threat_event: The owner, the only licensed officer, becomes unavailable for a long period and the organizational license and permit are at risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only one licensed officer; the second licensed broker is an employee, not an officer; no succession plan
existing_controls: Second individually licensed broker on staff
treatment_plan: Appoint the Entry Supervisor as a second officer; written succession plan; notify CBP within 10 days of any change in the qualifying officer

threat_event: Shipment documents exchanged with overseas agents in a consumer messaging app are lost with a phone or never filed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Messaging app on personal phones; no app protection; copies not filed in the shipment file
existing_controls: Phone passcodes
treatment_plan: Overseas agents send documents to a shared mailbox; suite app protection on phones; file messages that change a shipment

threat_event: Email with client documents sent to the wrong client
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-complete of addresses; similar client names; no second check for Form 5106 copies
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Encrypt messages containing Social Security numbers; double-check rule in training; turn off address auto-complete for external domains

threat_event: Hurricane closes the office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single office; no contingency plan
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from any location; 3 laptops
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: laptops home before landfall, office line forwarded, clients notified

threat_event: Unpatched firewall firmware exploited for remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware patched quarterly by the MSP; no vulnerability scanning; firewall login without MFA
existing_controls: MSP patching; no management interface exposed to the internet
treatment_plan: Quarterly external vulnerability scan; MFA on the firewall login

threat_event: Lost or stolen company laptop exposes client files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops leave the office with 3 staff
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on all laptops; MSP can wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encrypted data is excluded from Florida's personal information definition (501.171(1)(g)2); residual risk Low

threat_event: The Entry Supervisor does not complete 36 continuing education credits by 2027-01-31 and cannot certify compliance in the status report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 18 of 36 credits complete; certificates kept in personal email
existing_controls: Owner tracks his own credits
treatment_plan: Credit plan with approved courses booked by 2026-12-15; certificates filed in the compliance folder

threat_event: Attacker on the office network changes the printer's settings through its default administrator password and reads the stored entries@ credential
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Printer web page used the manufacturer's default password (found in P07 testing); printer stores the entries@ password
existing_controls: Office network not reachable from the internet
treatment_plan: MSP changed the printer password on 2026-08-14 and added the printer to patching and the inventory; credential removed under R-003

threat_event: A fraudster opens a client account with a stolen business or personal identity and uses the company to import goods under another person's importer number
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New client POAs are accepted by email with no identity check beyond a business card and a Form 5106 copy
existing_controls: POA executed directly with the importer
treatment_plan: New-client check: verify the business in state records and call a number from an independent source before the first entry; record the check; report separations under 111.32
